employees.label: Employees
employees.definition: People employed in the United States, per the 2025 Form 10-K (approximately).

source.label: eBay 2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we employed approximately 12,300 people globally, of which, approximately 7,200 were located in the United States.

sites.name: Headquarters
sites.description: eBay headquarters in San Jose, about 0.5 million square feet.

source.label: eBay 2025 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties
source.quote: Our headquarters are located in San Jose, California and occupies approximately 0.5 million square feet.

sites.name: Owned data centers
sites.description: All of eBay's owned data centers are in Utah.

source.label: eBay 2025 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties
source.quote: Our owned data centers are solely located in Utah.

notes: No state, country or regional breakdown found beyond the 10-K. The FY2025 10-K gives ~12,300 employees, ~7,200 in the U.S. (US country row), and says eBay owns and leases properties in the United States and 23 other countries, with 1.8 million sq ft in the U.S. and 0.9 million sq ft in other countries for continuing operations (no per-country detail). eBay Main Street (ebaymainstreet.com, eBay's public-policy site) was rechecked on 2026-11-24: its home page and reports page (whose only report is a July 2026 paper on second-hand goods in global trade) give no state figures, and its old per-state small-business pages had already returned 404. Older eBay state seller statistics turned up only in search results and were not fetched or used.
